# RapidTables.com

> > RapidTables.com is a comprehensive collection of free online calculators, converters, and reference tools for mathematics, finance, academics, engineering, and web design.

RapidTables provides practical calculation and conversion tools for students, professionals, and everyday users. The site covers academic grading, financial planning, health metrics, electrical engineering, and technical reference materials.

## Key Topics

- Scientific Calculator
- GPA Calculator
- Mortgage Calculator
- Grade Calculator
- BMI Calculator
- Compound Interest
- Percentage Calculator
- RGB Color Codes
- ASCII Table
- Electrical Calculators
- Wire Gauge
- Lighting Calculations
- Financial Calculators
- Math Calculators
- Academic Tools

## Mathematics & Calculations

- [Scientific Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/math/calculator.html): Scientific calculator with trigonometric and logarithmic functions
- [Math Calculators Directory](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/math/index.html): Math calculator directory covering arithmetic, trigonometry, statistics
- [Percentage Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/math/percentage-calculator.html): Online percentage calculator with step-by-step calculations
- [Fractions Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/math/fractions-calculator.html): Fractions calculator for arithmetic operations with whole numbers
- [Average Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/math/average-calculator.html): Mean, median, mode, and standard deviation calculator

## Academic & Grade Tools

- [GPA Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/grade/gpa-calculator.html): GPA calculator supporting AP and IB credit hour calculations
- [Grade Calculators Directory](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/grade/index.html): Grade calculator directory for GPA and academic calculations
- [Grade Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/grade/grade-calculator.html): Calculate weighted percentage and letter grades for academics
- [Final Grade Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/grade/final-grade-calculator.html): Final exam and weighted grade calculator for students

## Financial & Investment Calculators

- [Financial Calculators Directory](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/finance/index.html): Finance calculators including mortgage, tax, and interest tools
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/finance/mortgage-calculator.html): Simple home mortgage calculator for loan payments
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/finance/compound-interest-calculator.html): Compound interest calculator for investment planning

## Health & Wellness Tools

- [BMI Calculator](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/body/bmi-calculator.html): Body Mass Index calculator for men, women, and kids

## Engineering & Electrical Tools

- [Electrical Calculators](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/electric/index.html): Electrical calculators for voltage, current, and power calculations
- [Wire Gauge Calculations](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/wire/index.html): Wire gauge calculator for AWG, SWG, and voltage drop calculations
- [Lighting Calculators](https://www.rapidtables.com/calc/light/index.html): Lighting calculators for lumens, lux, and candela conversions

## Technical Reference & Code Tables

- [RGB Color Codes Chart](https://www.rapidtables.com/web/color/RGB_Color.html): RGB color codes chart with hex conversion for web design
- [ASCII Table](https://www.rapidtables.com/code/text/ascii-table.html): ASCII character codes reference with hex, decimal, binary conversions
